items.description: One flow: a logical change following control flow across files.

classification.description: Classification. `behavioural`: Changes observable behaviour. `api_contract`: Changes a public API or contract. `new_code`: Adds new code. `refactor_pure`: Claimed refactor without behaviour change. `move`: Moves code. `rename`: Renames identifiers. `test`: Test code. `docs_comments`: Documentation and comments. `generated_mechanical`: Generated or mechanical changes. `config_build`: Configuration and build. `dependency`: Dependency changes. `other`: Anything else.

importance_rank.description: Reading priority: 1 = read first; unique per flow.

intent.description: What the flow does, imperative, with the entry points.

hunks.description: The hunks of this flow, whole or as head-line sub-ranges.

items.description: A whole hunk (`head_start` and `head_end` null) or a head-line sub-range of it.

hunk_id.description: Hunk id from the hunk list.

head_start.description: First head line of the sub-range, or null for the whole hunk.

head_end.description: Last head line of the sub-range, or null for the whole hunk.

depends_on.description: Ids of flows this flow depends on.

items.description: Identifier of a flow, assigned by the `plan` job: `f1`, `f2`, ….

flows.description: Flows; every listed hunk line belongs to exactly one flow or to `unassigned`.

items.description: A hunk or sub-range that belongs to no flow.

hunk_id.description: Hunk id from the hunk list.

head_start.description: First head line of the sub-range, or null for the whole hunk.

head_end.description: Last head line of the sub-range, or null for the whole hunk.

reason.description: Why it belongs to no flow.

unassigned.description: Hunks or hunk sub-ranges that belong to no flow, each with a reason.

description: The flows of the pull request and the hunks left unassigned.
